notes:
- New: Virtual desktops — save per-desktop wallpapers and auto-apply on switch.
- Fixed: Black monitors after rearranging hardware — detection now uses QueryDisplayConfig device paths, no more ghost-clobbering.
- Fixed: Silent apply failures on large images — transform cache now uses JPEG to stay under Explorer's transcoder size limit.
- Fixed: Apply All no longer aborts on first failure; reports per-monitor success/failure.
- Faster: Poll-until-verified replaces fixed settle sleeps — typical apply is noticeably snappier.
